sn43.1:1.1: evamme sutaṃ ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassārāme. tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesa bhikkhavoti. bhadanteti te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ. bhagavā etadavoca
sn43.1:1.2: asaṅkhatañca vo bhikkhave desissāmi asaṅkhatagāmiñca maggaṃ
sn43.1:2.1: iti kho bhikkhave desitaṃ vo mayā asaṅkhataṃ desito asaṅkhatagāmimaggo.
sn43.1:2.2: yaṃ bhikkhave satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hitesinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya kataṃ vo taṃ mayā.
sn43.1:2.3: etāni bhikkhave rukkhamūlāni etāni suññāgārāni. jhāyatha bhikkhave mā pamādattha mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha. ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanīti.
